questions.q: `books` jadvalida 16 qator, `rating` ustuni 4 qatorda NULL. `WHERE rating >= 4.5` 5 qator qaytardi. `WHERE NOT (rating >= 4.5)` nechta qator qaytaradi?
questions.why: NULL qatorlar uchun ikkala shart ham UNKNOWN va ikkala natijadan tushadi: NULL bo'lmagan 16 - 4 = 12 qatordan 12 - 5 = 7.

questions.q: `WHERE genre = 'roman' OR genre = 'nazm' AND price < 50` qanday o'qiladi?
options: (genre = 'roman' OR genre = 'nazm') AND price < 50
genre = 'roman' OR (genre = 'nazm' AND price < 50)
Shartlar chapdan o'ngga ketma-ket, ustunliksiz
SQLite bunday shartni sintaksis xatosi deb rad etadi
questions.why: AND OR dan kuchliroq bog'lanadi, xuddi ko'paytirish qo'shishdan oldin bajarilgani kabi. Shuning uchun barcha romanlar narxidan qat'i nazar chiqadi.

questions.q: 12 ta bahoning yig'indisi 51.9, jadvalda 16 qator (4 tasining bahosi NULL). `AVG(rating)` nimaga teng?
options: NULL, chunki ustunda NULL bor
questions.why: AVG NULL qiymatlarni maxrajga ham, suratga ham qo'shmaydi: 51.9 / 12 = 4.325. 3.24375 esa SUM / COUNT(*) natijasi.

questions.q: Qaysi so'rov xato beradi yoki niyatga mos ishlamaydi?
options: SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM books GROUP BY genre HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) AS n FROM books GROUP BY genre ORDER BY n DESC
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE COUNT(*) > 3 GROUP BY genre
SELECT genre, COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE price > 100 GROUP BY genre
questions.why: WHERE guruhlashdan oldin, har bir qator uchun ishlaydi, u paytda aggregat hali hisoblanmagan. Guruh sharti HAVING da yoziladi.

questions.q: Sahifada 20 ta mahsulot ko'rsatiladi. 7-sahifa uchun qaysi qism to'g'ri?
options: LIMIT 20 OFFSET 140
LIMIT 7 OFFSET 20
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 120
LIMIT 140 OFFSET 20

questions.q: `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books WHERE id NOT IN (1, 2, NULL)` nechta qator sanaydi (jadvalda 16 qator, id hech qachon NULL emas)?
questions.why: x NOT IN (1, 2, NULL) bu x <> 1 AND x <> 2 AND x <> NULL. Oxirgi qism doim UNKNOWN, shuning uchun shart hech qachon TRUE bo'lmaydi.

questions.q: Bir xil `SELECT title FROM books ORDER BY rating LIMIT 3` so'rovi SQLite va PostgreSQL'da turli natija berdi. Eng ehtimolli sabab?
options: SQLite NULL'ni eng kichik, PostgreSQL eng katta deb saralaydi, shuning uchun bahosiz kitoblar birida boshida, birida oxirida
PostgreSQL LIMIT ni ORDER BY dan oldin bajaradi
SQLite REAL ustunlarni satr sifatida saralaydi
PostgreSQL'da ORDER BY sukut bo'yicha DESC
questions.why: SQLite hujjati bo'yicha NULL ASC da boshida, PostgreSQL'da esa oxirida. Natijani bir xil qilish uchun NULLS FIRST yoki NULLS LAST yoziladi.

questions.q: Ikki so'rov: (A) `WHERE price > 100 GROUP BY genre` va (B) `GROUP BY genre HAVING MAX(price) > 100`. Ikkalasida ham `SELECT genre, COUNT(*)`. Texnik janrda 5 kitob, ulardan 4 tasi 100 dan qimmat. Texnik qatorida qanday sonlar chiqadi?
questions.why: A da WHERE arzon kitobni guruhlashdan oldin tashlaydi, 4 qoladi. B da hamma 5 kitob sanaladi, HAVING faqat guruhni tanlaydi.

questions.q: `DELETE FROM books WHERE year < 2010` ni bajarishdan oldin eng to'g'ri qadam qaysi?
options: Shartni olib tashlab, avval DELETE FROM books ni sinab ko'rish
Xuddi shu WHERE bilan SELECT COUNT(*) bajarib, sonni tekshirish, keyin DELETE va changes() bilan solishtirish
DELETE ... LIMIT 1 yozish: SQLite bu sintaksisni har doim qo'llaydi
Avval UPDATE bilan year ni NULL qilish
questions.why: Bir xil WHERE bilan SELECT qaysi qatorlarga tegilishini oldindan ko'rsatadi. DELETE ... LIMIT SQLite'da faqat maxsus kompilyatsiya opsiyasi bilan bor.

questions.q: Nega `SELECT price * 2 AS d FROM books ORDER BY d` ishlaydi, `SELECT price * 2 AS d FROM books WHERE d > 100` esa standart SQL'da (masalan, PostgreSQL'da) xato?
options: Alias faqat bitta harfli bo'lsa WHERE da ishlamaydi
WHERE da faqat indekslangan ustunlar ishlatiladi
Mantiqiy tartibda WHERE SELECT dan oldin, ORDER BY esa keyin bajariladi, alias SELECT qadamida paydo bo'ladi
ORDER BY so'rovning birinchi qadami
questions.why: FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, SELECT, DISTINCT, ORDER BY, LIMIT. WHERE ishlayotganda alias hali yo'q. SQLite bu yerda yumshoq, lekin bunday kod ko'chirilmaydi.
